headline: Last session: Nifty ends at 22,600 as surging oil prices and geopolitical tensions snap two-week market gains

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Brent crude oil prices surged past $117 per barrel following Houthi-Saudi attacks
Escalating geopolitical tensions in West Asia weighed heavily on investor sentiment
Profit booking occurred after the market had achieved two consecutive weeks of gains
High global energy costs dragged Indian equities to significant weekly losses
whatHappening: The Sensex shed approximately 1,600 points during a turbulent trading week ending October 23
BPCL reported a significant Q2 profit swing to Rs 4,993 crore from a previous loss
SEBI imposed an Rs 11.5 crore penalty and ordered a Rs 546 crore refund against a trading academy
Maharashtra FDA suspended the license of a Blinkit warehouse in Bhiwandi and filed an FIR
summary: In the last trading session, Indian markets snapped a two-week winning streak as the Nifty settled at 22,600 amid rising oil prices. Brent crude surged past $117 following geopolitical tensions, weighing heavily on domestic equities despite some buying interest in IT stocks. Corporate earnings remained in focus with BPCL reporting a return to profitability and Infosys declaring a dividend.
